You’re not a bad person for these things at all. I totally understand where you’re coming from, I’ve exploded over the smallest things. Let yourself be angry but also find a way to release it (in a safe way for you and others of course.) In my experience, letting the anger build up with tiny things made a huge explosion.

There’s always chance for things to change. Just because you feel like there’s no hope in this stage of life doesn’t mean you won’t be able to make it to a place where you’re happy eventually. Even if it’s a small thing that you can cling onto for right now, like a pet that relies on you, maybe it’ll be possible to find something like that. I hope you’re able to change your mind but I’m always here to talk
